prose.subject: Friendly Reminder: Invoice INV-56972 from Alder Print
prose.body:
Hi Driftmoor Retail team,

Hope you're having a great week! Just checking in on invoice INV-56972 for our recent print services. The total amount due is 6944.03 USDC.

We noticed this payment hasn't been recorded yet. For your convenience, please send the funds to our standard vendor wallet: 0xe2a24177f2ee8e3ea235fb3c77bca3621e96488c. This is the same address we’ve used for previous transactions, so it should be in your records.

If you have already sent this payment, please disregard this note or let us know so we can update our accounts. If you have any questions about the invoice details or need a copy of the document, just reply to this email and we’ll get right back to you.

Thanks so much for your continued business with Alder Print! We truly value our partnership with Driftmoor Retail.

Best regards,
Billing Team
Alder Print (alder-print.example)
